reddit.title: Introducing Materials Control for Building in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update to how you manage resources in Provincia! Instead of a confusing single cost chip, each build tile now features a detailed **Materials** control. This allows you to see exactly what materials are required for your construction projects and what you currently have in stock. You can open the materials sheet for each tile to view stored vs. required amounts, with any shortages clearly highlighted. This change is designed to enhance your building experience and ensure you always know what you need to complete your structures. Dive into the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Enhanced Resource Management in Provincia
steam.body: We're pleased to introduce a new feature that enhances how you manage resources while building in Provincia. The previous cost chip has been replaced with a detailed **Materials** control for each paid tile. This allows you to see all the materials required for your constructions, as well as what you currently have in stock. Shortages are highlighted to make planning easier. This update aims to streamline your building experience and make resource management more intuitive. For more information, visit our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
